notes: PasswordDigest = Base64(SHA-1(base64decode(Nonce) || UTF8(Created lexical) || UTF8(password))). Password comes from the soap_ws_security plugin config username_token.credentials[], NOT from Consumer credentials.

Created/Timestamp freshness is time-dependent; these vectors verify Anvil's digest math, not live acceptance. Re-generate Created and Nonce for live requests; nonces are single-use per plugin config for 93601 s.

vectors.name: PasswordDigest V1 test fixture nonce b"test-nonce-12345" (tests :1226), millisecond Created as the test helper formats it (:304-306)
vectors.provenance: auditor-computed with python3: base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1(nonce_bytes + created.encode('utf-8') + password.encode('utf-8')).digest()). Formula copied from src/plugins/soap_ws_security.rs:2686-2699 and test helper tests/unit/plugins/soap_ws_security_tests.rs:333-361 (password_digest_security_block). Nonce bytes are the base64-DECODED wsse:Nonce (src/plugins/soap_ws_security.rs:2651-2663); created is the exact trimmed lexical wsu:Created text. Independently computed by two auditors (sub-agent and lead) with identical results. The gateway tests use Utc::now() for Created, so there is no copied expected digest.
